facts.fact: The article calls the Cybercrime Act of 2025 Liberia's recently enacted law and reports police charging a suspect under it on 21-22 September 2026.

Police detained commentator Jerry Nyantee Wrato from 17 September 2026 over AI-generated images of the Vice President and, per the Inspector General's 21 September letter, resolved to prosecute him under Sections 10.1, 15.1, 18.1 and 19.1 of the Act (misuse of devices, cyberstalking, incitement, harmful data messages); a court ordered him released on habeas corpus on 22 September.
